findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (RCS 758), passed 66-47
findings.note: Voted aye on second reading of HB 958. The 2026 version requires a county board to process a registration only if the applicant affirmatively states US citizenship (with a 30-day sworn-statement cure if left blank), and sets up removal of voters flagged as non-citizens from a federal database. The bill text does not add a photo-ID rule.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Motion 11 Concur (RCS 801), passed 62-47
findings.note: Voted aye on concurring with the Senate changes to HB 958, the final House vote on the bill (same citizenship-on-registration and non-citizen removal provisions).
